info.title: Data Hub API
info.description: Integrator REST API for Data Hub. Authenticate with a personal access token (`Authorization: Bearer dhub_…`). Session cookies also work for browser callers.

servers.description: Relative to your Data Hub host

tags.name: Runs
tags.description: Instrument runs, comments, attributions, uploads, and search
